name: speedketchup
description: Runs an internet speed test every 10 minutes against the nearest speedtest.net server, stores the results in a csv file and shows them in a builtin web page. The web page has speed and latency charts with distributions of the displayed results, daily, monthly, time of day and time of week averages, and a sortable table of every result. A single statically linked binary of a few hundred kilobytes, the image has nothing else in it.

paths.name: Results
paths.description: Where the test results csv file is stored.

ports.name: WebUI
ports.description: Web page with the test results.

variables.name: Speedtest server
variables.description: Speedtest server host[:port] to always test against, empty picks the server with the lowest latency for every test.

variables.name: Download duration
variables.description: Seconds to test the download speed, 0 skips the download test.

variables.name: Upload duration
variables.description: Seconds to test the upload speed, 0 skips the upload test.

variables.name: Download connections
variables.description: Parallel connections for the download test.

variables.name: Upload connections
variables.description: Parallel connections for the upload test.

variables.name: InfluxDB write url
variables.description: InfluxDB line protocol write url to also write every result to, http only, eg http://influxdb:8086/api/v2/write?org=home&bucket=speedketchup. Empty writes nowhere.

variables.name: InfluxDB token
variables.description: Token for the InfluxDB write url.

variables.name: MQTT broker
variables.description: MQTT broker host[:port] to also publish every result to, with Home Assistant discovery, plain mqtt only, port 1883 by default. Empty publishes nowhere.

variables.name: MQTT user
variables.description: User name for the MQTT broker.
